welcome.restore_detail: Start a new profile from your existing recovery phrase

fusion.unlock_to_show_values: Unlock and verify the chain to display wallet values.
pages.receive_subtitle: One genuine BIP352 silent-payment code. A new on-chain destination for each sender.
pages.receive_scope: REGTEST only · BIP352 · never a reusable public address
pages.copy_full_value: The copied value is never shortened.
pages.history_subtitle: Credit is owned outputs, including change. Debit is spent owned inputs. Net change is credit minus debit; outgoing net includes the fee.
pages.search_placeholder: Search transaction ID or block height
pages.select_row: Select a row to inspect its exact confirmed data.
pages.network_subtitle: Isolated or Shared REGTEST connectivity from the owned Core. This is not a new P2P protocol.
pages.unknown_until_verified: Unknown fields stay unknown until the owned Core verifies them.
pages.peers_after_check: Peer count is shown only after a verified network check
pages.height_after_snapshot: Chain height is shown only after a verified snapshot
pages.sync_unknown: Sync status is unknown until Core is verified
pages.shared_identity_scope: Shared network identity is shown only for a configured Shared REGTEST profile
pages.v1_net_commands: Existing V1-NET commands only. No automatic peer discovery.
pages.isolated_zero_peer: Isolated REGTEST keeps the Q06 zero-peer profile.
pages.silent_payments_note: Silent payments avoid publishing a reusable destination on-chain. The wallet scans confirmed blocks using its native WSP-1 account. This is not an anonymity guarantee.
pages.disposable_funds: Use disposable REGTEST funds only. Never import a personal production key or send real value.
pages.manual_peer: Manual connect/disconnect uses the configured Shared REGTEST peer.
owner.fund_receive: Fund 1 test receive on fresh REGTEST
wallet.sidebar_notice:
WAM Fusion  ·  Qt  ·  WAM Core (REGTEST)
No real funds or mainnet keys.
wallet.refresh_tooltip: Verify the latest state with your owned WAM Core
wallet.send_subtitle: Prepare, review, approve signature and broadcast as separate actions.
wallet.review_subtitle: Signing reserves inputs. Broadcast is a separate explicit approval.
wallet.no_prepared_payment: No prepared payment. Recipient, amount, fee and change appear here after Review.
wallet.no_broadcast_result: No broadcast result yet. An uncertain outcome is never hidden or retried.
wallet.no_automatic_retry: Unknown broadcast status never triggers an automatic retry.
wallet.security_subtitle: Wallet protection, backup status and advanced custody controls stay separate.
wallet.protection_subtitle: Lock and unlock reflect authenticated backend custody only.
wallet.seed_support_warning: 12 words are shown only at creation; never send seed words to a support agent.
wallet.recovery_subtitle: Check your saved words against this REGTEST chain. This does not restore spending access.
wallet.restore_scope_notice: Restoring from 12 words recovers keys and confirmed history only. Signed, pending or uncertain payments stay with the profile that made them. A missing record here never means a payment failed or is safe to retry. If the original profile is unavailable, the status of its unfinished payments stays unknown.
wallet.backup_requirement: Keep your 12 words private. Confirmation checks three words from your written backup.
wallet.recovery_support_warning: Recovery words are shown only at creation. Never send them to a support agent.
wallet.settings_subtitle: Appearance, ordinary preferences and separate developer diagnostics.
wallet.appearance_body: Automatic follows macOS appearance. Light and Dark apply immediately.
wallet.about_body: Local-first BIP352 silent payments. No remote account or cloud custody.
wallet.preview_notice: This preview is not a mainnet wallet. All test transactions stay on the owned REGTEST chain.
wallet.advanced_body: For technical acceptance and test-chain diagnostics only.
wallet.fee_is_network: The network sets this fee. Review shows the fee, the total debit and the available balance before Sign.
pages.copy_complete: Copy includes the entire verified address.
pages.broadcast_reply_uncertain: An uncertain broadcast reply retains reservations. Do not assume it failed.
